reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Isotope tracing, step blockade/restoration and proposed biochemical reconstitution.

checks.reason: No prior Methods/supplement/validated-protocol consultation and detailed condition transfer before execution.

IRR is initially k_dil/k_dep (dimensionless), but the fallback when k_dep approaches zero is k_dil (inverse time), still compared to one. Changing units does not create a meaningful replacement threshold.
Buffer/ion/cofactor preparation conditions and quantities remain unspecified without a concrete procedure to choose them.
CAF divides integrated oxidation by net intermediate consumption; conserved catalyst gives zero/near-zero denominator. No finite alternate estimand or denominator rule resolves the cycling case.
Three independent preparations and technical repeats are distinguished, but no precision/power or independent-unit pilot justification supports that count.

The catalytic amplification ceiling does not account for stoichiometric carbon/oxygen yield per intermediate; measuring inhibitor in wash fluid also does not establish residual concentration in the preparation itself.
Low/high dose categories are not a bounded quantitative sensitivity design with objective selection and a confirmatory parameter lock.
No explicit refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after troubleshooting changes.

Difference-in-differences in oxidation and label dilution do not uniquely identify closed return. A noncycling activator can depend on the same inhibited step, and degradation plus replenishment can dilute label without cycling.
Washed/dialyzed tissue with intended small molecules added back is not a compositionally defined enzyme inventory; parallel enzyme activities remain.
No sample/raw-file/model/code/environment/settings audit trail.

Prospective sham/inactive/vehicle and isotope-matrix controls, source/integrity records, measured standards with recovery gates, randomized blinded allocation, technical stops, mixed-preparation uncertainty/multiplicity and cause-based repairs are useful. The final scope is cautious, but the primary quantitative and causal tests still require substantial correction. Their overclaim is charged under P13 only.
